canDo: Can give a linear 3–5-minute opinion on a general topic and discuss it.
review: Review opinion, cause and effect, examples, concession.
output: 10 minutes’ preparation → a 3–5-minute recording → ask yourself follow-up questions.
checkpoint: Topic introduced, opinion, 2 reasons, an example, a concession and a conclusion all present.
challenge: Today’s challenge: pick a media or technology story in RFI’s « Journal en français facile ». After 10 minutes’ preparation, record a 3–5-minute point de vue: a clear position, two arguments each with an example, an opposing view and a conclusion, with at least 1 emphatic sentence (C'est… qui… / Ce qui compte, c'est…); when you listen back, ask yourself 3 examiner-style follow-ups (Pourquoi ? Un exemple ? Et si on vous dit le contraire ?) and answer them aloud.
